IGUI_PhunInteriors_NoRoomSet: That interior type is not configured
IGUI_PhunInteriors_NoFreeRoom: No interiors are free right now
IGUI_PhunInteriors_RoomClosed: That interior is closed right now
IGUI_PhunInteriors_RoomNotInWorld: This interior is missing from your world
IGUI_PhunInteriors_ZombiesTooClose: Too dangerous to climb in right now
IGUI_PhunInteriors_VehicleGone: Your vehicle is no longer where you left it
IGUI_PhunInteriors_VehicleMoving: You cannot climb out while it is moving
IGUI_PhunInteriors_VehicleMovingBoard: You cannot climb aboard while it is moving
IGUI_PhunInteriors_BoardAtRear: You get in from the back
IGUI_PhunInteriors_BoardAtDoor: You get in by the door
IGUI_PhunInteriors_BoardingUnreachable: You cannot get to the door
IGUI_PhunInteriors_DrivingCannotEnter: Not while you are at the wheel
IGUI_PhunInteriors_RoomReclaimed: Your old interior sat unused and was cleared out. This one is empty
IGUI_PhunInteriors_RoomLost: The interior you were in is no longer yours. You are back where you went in
IGUI_PhunInteriors_CannotDamage: The shell of this room will not give
IGUI_PhunInteriors_HolderOccupied: Somebody is inside. You cannot pack this away.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_HolderNotEmpty: Empty the room inside before you pack this away
IGUI_PhunInteriors_HolderPermanent: This is fixed in place. It cannot be moved or taken apart.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_ReservoirInstalled: The rain barrels are up on the roof
IGUI_PhunInteriors_ReservoirNotHere: This room cannot take a reservoir
IGUI_PhunInteriors_ReservoirNoRoof: There is no roof here to put barrels on
IGUI_PhunInteriors_ReservoirNotInside: You need to be inside your room
IGUI_PhunInteriors_ReservoirNoKit: You need a rain reservoir kit
IGUI_PhunInteriors_AdminUsage: /interiors rooms | list | enter <room> [index] | release <room> <index> | free <vehicleId> | scrub [room index] | power [room index] | evict <username> | shove [radius] | remanifest <room> <index>
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Tip_Enter: Lease a slot of this room and go and stand in it. With no slot selected, the next free one.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Slot_InUse: That slot is leased. Release it before deleting it.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Binding_NoEditMatcher: This binding uses a code predicate, which cannot be edited here
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Binding_NeedsRoom: A binding has to name at least one room
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Tip_Save: Write every change to PhunInteriors.json in the game's Lua folder. Changes apply the moment you make them; this is what keeps them across a restart.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Tip_Discard: Throw away every unsaved change and re-read the file
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Tip_OnlyChanged: Show only rows that differ from what was registered in code
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Tip_HideTemplates: Hide rows that exist only to be inherited from
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_RoomId: Namespaced, like yourmod.room.van. This is what a lease remembers, so it can never be changed later.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Size: The FOOTPRINT, not the floor. This map puts the south and east walls outside the floor, so a 2x3 floor is a 3x4 footprint.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Spawn: An offset into the room, not a world position. Must be a square a tenant can stand on.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_FirstStamp: Where you are standing. Add the rest from the Slots tab.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Front: Which edge of the room faces the front of whatever is carrying it. 'none' lands the tenant beside the vehicle, which is a real answer.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Cab: Leaving by the front edge puts the tenant in a seat instead of on the ground. Needs a front edge to mean anything.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_HasGenerator: Off means no power at all. There is no default position, because a wrong one looks deliberate.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Generator: An offset from the room. Must be outside the room, on an exterior square, and within 20 tiles of every tile of the floor.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_SelfPowered: The generator needs no fuel from the holder. It still needs a generator position, or the room is simply dark.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Reservoir: Whether a rain reservoir kit may be installed on the roof
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_SingleUse: When the last person leaves, the room is handed back and scrubbed at once, so the next arrival finds it as the map built it
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Shared: Every object bound to this room opens onto the same space, wherever it stands, and everyone comes back out where they went in. It is never reclaimed or scrubbed except by an admin.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_HardenShell: server follows the Unbreakable Outer Walls sandbox option. always and never ignore it for this room: its walls cannot be destroyed and fires in it are put out, or neither.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Permanent: Every object this binding matches refuses to be picked up, disassembled or destroyed, by anybody. Use a sprite nothing else in the world uses.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Priority: Lower is handed out first, among rooms reachable by the same vehicles. Only a preference: it never overrides specificity.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_BaseWeight: What the fitted room weighs before anybody puts anything in it
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_BindingId: Namespaced, like yourmod.vans. Re-using an id replaces that binding.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Kind: Whether this binds vehicles or placed world objects. It decides which register call is made, so it is not cosmetic.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Scripts: Full script names, like Base.StepVan. Read one off the vehicle's mod page.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_Sprites: Sprite names, like fixtures_bathroom_01_0. Any facing of it matches, and so does any tile of a multi-tile object when you name its first tile.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_BindingRooms: Adds these rooms to what the scripts above can reach. It never takes a vehicle away from another binding.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_SlotIndex: The index is what a lease remembers and cannot be changed. Delete and add to renumber.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_NewSlotIndex: The next unused index. Never re-use a deleted one: a lease may still name it.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Hint_SlotPosition: The north-west corner of the footprint, in world coordinates. Run scripts/roomcheck.pl against the map after saving.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Confirm_RevertRoom: Put %1 back to the room its code registered, throwing away every change made here?
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Confirm_DeleteRoom: %1 exists only because you made it. Deleting it removes the room and every stamp of it, and any lease on one is lost.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Confirm_DeleteSlot: Delete slot %1 of %2? Its index stays a gap, so no other lease moves.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Confirm_DisableBindin: %1 was registered in code. Removing it here lasts until the next restart, when its mod registers it again.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Confirm_Discard: Throw away every unsaved change and go back to what is in PhunInteriors.json?
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Err_RangeBoth: Give both ends of the range
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Err_RangeOrder: The first must not be greater than the second
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Tip_Recapture: Take the room as it looks right now as what a scrub restores. Stand in it first so it is loaded.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Tip_Scrub: Put the room back to its blueprint now. Whoever holds it keeps it, but anything left lying about is cleared.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Confirm_Recapture: Take slot %1 of %2 as it looks now as its blueprint? Every later scrub restores to this.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Confirm_Scrub: Scrub slot %1 of %2 now? Anything anybody has left in it is cleared, including if they are standing in it.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Tip_Reset: Drop whoever holds this slot. Everything in the room is cleared out the next time it is handed to anybody.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Slot_Claimed: That slot is somebody's safehouse. The claim has to go first.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Confirm_Reset: Reset slot %1 of %2? Whoever holds it loses it, and everything in the room is cleared out the next time it is handed to anybody.
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Confirm_CloseUnsaved: You have changes that are not in PhunInteriors.json. They are live now, but a restart will lose them. Close anyway?
IGUI_PhunInteriors_Trespassing: Somebody has claimed this interior as a safehouse
